## Personality

Joshua Pye is a surly and taciturn individual. He possesses an unsociable nature, preferring to work in solitude and independence.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024)_

## History

Joshua Pye was hired by the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) to paint the village hall green. Due to a mix-up with paint numbers, he instead painted the hall a bright blue. Despite the hideous outcome, the incident unexpectedly turned public sympathy in favor of the society as the community rallied around them.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
